pr_title: Prevent crash when dropping Resource that can't load

issue_context.title: Holding Ctrl while dragging a CSV file into a script crashes Godot 4.2.1
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

v4.2.1.stable.official [b09f793f5]

### System information

Godot v4.2.1.stable - Windows 10.0.22631 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5212) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900H (20 Threads)

### Issue description

I am not versed on how csv's are imported. First time testing it, and I see it imported it as a translation file. I need to read up on those. I was just using it as essentially a comma separated value to parse into an array later. So not sure if preload is needed for any of that, but by habit did that, and noticed the crash.

### Steps to reproduce

Make a new scene
Add script to scene
While holding Ctrl drag test.csv file from file list to script
Godot then crashes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP CSV crash.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/14964494/MRP.CSV.crash.zip)

review_comments: Would it make sense to always use this approach and save a costly `load`? Or it's not enough for some types of resources?
`_get_dropped_resource_line()` also uses resource name, which currently can't be obtained without loading the Resource. Otherwise the method could just take path string.
